descriptions.w3d_d28e_match_node_801d3930: Match a parsed node against the expected name. In sequence mode it compares with the name at the current index of the list at +48 and returns 1 until the last name; otherwise with the single name at +40. A full match records the node at +44, pushes it on the stack at +72 and returns 0x90000005. Otherwise 0. Reached through the secondary base at +4.
